text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The rehab she underwent with Marvelous 
Sunday proved effective. In fact, her leg 
condition was even better than before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though the road was by no means smooth, 
the preparations for the race were 
complete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Filling her heart with all things 
marvelous and dedicating herself to
rehab, 
not a single trace of doubt remained 
before her.
—Time to take on the Challenge Cup.
